title: [Quant] Load compressed-tensors quantized lm_head instead of value-casting it
body:
## Motivation

compressed-tensors checkpoints that quantize `lm_head` (e.g. FP8 per-channel weights targeted via `re:.*lm_head`) currently load as gibberish: `CompressedTensorsConfig.get_quant_method` returns `None` for `ParallelLMHead`, so the head falls back to `UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod` — the packed fp8 weight is value-cast into a bf16 parameter and `lm_head.weight_scale` is silently dropped (`Parameter lm_head.weight_scale not found in params_dict` at load).

## Modifications

- `CompressedTensorsConfig.get_quant_method`: add a `ParallelLMHead` branch that resolves a linear scheme and returns `CompressedTensorsLinearMethod` (mirroring the existing ModelOpt handling); unquantized heads keep the current embedding default.
- New `get_lm_head_scheme`: the head is treated as quantized only when a config target names it by layer name (exact, `re:` regex, or dotted suffix) and it is not in `ignore`. Module-type targets like `Linear` are not consulted, so checkpoints following the common convention (head unquantized and unmentioned) are unaffected. The resolved target is passed through to `get_scheme_dict` so suffix matches are not re-derived by the stricter `find_matched_target`. Block-FP8 heads are rejected with a clear error (the vocab-parallel weight loader cannot shard `vocab/block_n` weight scales).
- Unit test: `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_compressed_tensors_lm_head.py` (CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`).

No other changes needed: the vocab-parallel weight loader already shards `output_dim=0` params, the model loader already runs `process_weights_after_loading` on the head, and the logits path already routes through `should_apply_lm_head_quant_method`.

Known limits: models that construct `ParallelLMHead` without a `prefix` keep today's unquantized-head behavior (the empty layer name never matches a target); `update_weights_from_disk` with a quantized head is untested; speculative-decoding draft paths that borrow the target head are a separate follow-up.

## Accuracy Tests

A/B on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell with a Qwen3.8-27B mixed-precision compressed-tensors checkpoint (NVFP4 MLPs, FP8 per-channel `lm_head`), identical flags, `sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions 200`:

| | GSM8K | Invalid |
|---|---|---|
| main | 0.000 | 0.850 |
| this PR | 0.955 | 0.000 |

On main, greedy decoding degenerates into repetition loops on any prompt; with this PR the head loads through `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8` and the `weight_scale` warning is gone.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No impact on unquantized-head checkpoints (resolution happens once at init). A quantized head replaces a bf16 matmul with the standard fp8 linear path.
